meta.title: Sustainable Connections — local businesses
meta.description: Every listing in Sustainable Connections' Local Business Directory (266 businesses and organisations, 282 locations), coloured by the directory's own nine sections. 239 are placed at a street address: the one the directory publishes, or, where it gives none, the one the business publishes itself (own website, Eat Local First, state business record or map listing). Every popup names its source. 27 home-based service businesses publish no address and sit at the neighbourhood the directory gives them; their popups say so. Businesses with several locations get one point each. Pick what to show groups by kind or by location. Inside Bellingham, a location is the City of Bellingham neighbourhood the address falls in (the business's own pick, which often differs, is kept in the CSV); elsewhere it is the directory's area name or the town. Being listed means being a member of Sustainable Connections, not an endorsement by RCN. Source: sustainableconnections.org/local-business-directory, read 2026-10-01; rebuild with tools/sc-directory/build.py. Compiled Oct 2026 by Marc Pierson with Claude Opus 5.5.
